Your holdings: CRWD (19.65%), QQQ (-11.3%), SMH (-33.62%), SMCI (-46.88%), SNOW (-20%), PLTU (-30.87%), MSFU (-16.66%), MU (-74.64%), SOXL (-85.75%), SPAL (-55.71%), QQQI (-15.53%), SPY (-2.41%), METU (-23.15%). Most are 'SELL' or 'TRIM' and deep in the red, amplified by margin. The leveraged ETFs are particularly brutal.

Watch: The semiconductor narrative is strong, but your leveraged chip ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MU) are bleeding badly. Keep an eye on SMCI and SMH as bellwethers.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply underwater, leveraged positions and respecting stops.
plays: Respect SMCI stop at 37.3. If it breaks, consider trimming further.
Consider trimming QQQ if it tests its stop at 670.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
